purpose: An interactive insurance underwriting simulation tool that allows users to model complex claim scenarios, visualize coverage gaps, and receive AI-powered optimization recommendations.

sections: Main Dashboard Grid (Left Sidebar Controls + Center Results + Right Sidebar Insights)

content_sections.name: Page Header
content_sections.heading: INTELLIGENT UNDERWRITING
items: Experience the power of precision underwriting. Simulate complex claim scenarios against your current policies to predict approval rates and coverage gaps instantly.

content_sections.name: Simulation Dashboard
items: CHOOSE POLICY: Health Shield Pro Plus dropdown
CHOOSE SCENARIO: Hospitalization (selected), Accident, Critical Illness, Surgery, Natural Disaster buttons
Scenario Parameters: Estimated Bill Amount ($25,000), Hospital Type (Tier 1 Multi-specialty), Room Type (Private Suite)
ESTIMATED CLAIM PAYOUT: $21,250.00 with 85% of bill covered badge
APPROVAL CONFIDENCE: 94% High with circular progress indicator
Coverage Risks: Non-Network Surcharge warning, Room Rent Cap Exceeded warning
Filing Checklist: Itemized Hospital Bill (checked), Discharge Summary (checked), Pre-Auth Letter (unchecked)

content_sections.name: Cost Breakdown Analysis
content_sections.heading: Cost Breakdown Analysis
items: Bar chart showing Hospital, Room Rent, Surgery, Medicine, Lab Tests with Covered Amount vs Out of Pocket legend

content_sections.name: AI Strategy Optimization
content_sections.heading: AI Strategy Optimization
content_sections.subheading: Based on your policy, shifting to St. Jude Preferred eliminates the non-network penalty, increasing your net payout by $2,500.

notes: This is a sophisticated B2B SaaS dashboard for insurance underwriting. The design uses a clean, professional aesthetic with blue as the primary action color. The layout is information-dense with clear visual hierarchy separating input controls (left), primary output (center), and secondary insights (right). All monetary values use dollar signs and comma separators. Warning states use red text for emphasis (10% co-pay, $200/day limit). The AI optimization section at the bottom serves as a smart recommendation engine overlay.
